create_pp_doclayout_v3_config: create a PPDocLayoutV3Config with backbone, encoder, decoder, and global pointer head settings for document layout detection
initialize_pp_doclayout_v3_model: initialize PPDocLayoutV3ForObjectDetection model from a PPDocLayoutV3Config instance with random weights
access_model_config_attributes: access PPDocLayoutV3Config attributes like d_model, num_queries, encoder_layers, and decoder_layers from a loaded model config
configure_backbone_hgnet_v2: configure the PPDocLayoutV3Config backbone as HGNetV2-L with frozen stem and stage output features
set_denoising_and_query_parameters: set PPDocLayoutV3Config denoising, label noise, box noise, and query parameters for training contrastive denoising detection
